// GREEN fixture for `flow-determinism` — the lint MUST admit this.
// @workflow-body
// The workflow body reads time and randomness ONLY through the deterministic WfCtx surface, so
// replay is deterministic (index 9.2, OQ-F).
pub async fn approval_workflow(ctx: &mut WfCtx) {
    let started = ctx.now();
    let nonce = ctx.rand();
    let _ = (started, nonce);
}
